workflow.critical: Generate all QA documents in {reporting_language} (Arabic by default)
Execute ALL steps in exact order — do NOT skip steps
Save artifacts after EACH phase completes — never batch phases
Never skip a phase even if prior phases produced warnings — collect ALL results
Output base path for all artifacts: {output_folder}/{story_id}/

ALL generated files (E2E tests, test cases, test data, bug reports, reports) MUST be written ONLY inside {output_folder}/{story_id}/ — which resolves to ai-qa-framework/TestResult/{story_id}/. NEVER write to any folder found in the host project such as e2e/, tests/, src/e2e/, src/test/, or similar. Those folders belong to the host project and must NEVER be touched.
SELF-REVIEW RULE: After every phase, execute the phase's review checklist before proceeding. Fix all failures before moving to the next phase.

step.goal: Resolve story files and suite name

check.ask: Please provide the path(s) to the user story file(s). You may provide multiple paths separated by spaces (e.g., docs/stories/1-1-feature.md docs/stories/1-2-feature.md):

step.action: Parse {story_files} into a list — split on spaces or commas, trim whitespace, filter empty entries
Derive {story_id} from the FIRST story filename (e.g., "1-1-opt-in-link-generation" from "1-1-opt-in-link-generation.md")
Read ALL story files completely; merge their acceptance criteria, scenarios, and edge cases into one unified set
Store {ac_count} = TOTAL number of unique acceptance criteria across ALL stories
If multiple stories provided, display: "Loaded {story_count} stories — {ac_count} total ACs merged"

quality-checklist.check: project.config.json exists and is valid JSON
frontend field is a real framework name — NOT null or "unknown"
backend.baseUrl is a real URL — NOT a placeholder
auth.scheme is populated
routes.pages contains at least one entry

review.fix-if-needed: P0-2 → re-scan package.json and entry files for framework detection P0-3 → ask user for base URL and update config P0-4/P0-5 → re-scan project structure; ask user if auto-detection fails Fix all issues before proceeding to Phase 1.

step.output: ✅ Phase 0 complete — project stack detected and verified in project.config.json

quality-checklist.check: Story AST JSON file exists and is valid parseable JSON
AST acceptance_criteria array has exactly {ac_count} items — every AC from ALL provided stories must be present
Each AC matches the original text from its source story — no omissions, no paraphrasing that loses meaning
At least 2 positive scenarios defined
At least 1 negative scenario per AC
Edge cases section is not empty
Security scenarios section covers unauthorised access and input injection

review.fix-if-needed: P1-2/P1-3 → re-read ALL story files in {story_files} and add any missing ACs to the AST P1-4/P1-5 → add missing positive/negative scenarios P1-6 → add boundary, empty-input, and special-character edge cases P1-7 → add auth bypass and injection security scenarios Save corrected AST before proceeding to Phase 2.

step.output: ✅ Phase 1 complete — story AST verified: {ac_count} ACs captured, all scenario sections populated

step.action:
Command: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs generate-test-cases --stories "{story_files}"
XLSX test cases MD test cases
Both XLSX and MD files exist at the correct paths Every AC from ALL provided stories has at least one positive test case — total positive tests ≥ {ac_count} Every AC has at least one negative test case covering invalid/rejected input Edge case test cases are present (boundary values, empty inputs, max-length, special characters) Each test case has: ID, title, preconditions, numbered steps, expected result — no field is blank Expected results are specific and measurable — NOT vague ("system works correctly") No duplicate test case IDs All text content is in {reporting_language}
P2-2/P2-3 → add missing test cases for uncovered ACs and negative scenarios P2-4 → add at least 3 edge case tests P2-5 → fill any blank fields with accurate content P2-6 → rewrite vague expected results to be specific and measurable P2-7 → renumber any duplicate IDs P2-8 → translate all content to {reporting_language} Save corrected files before proceeding to Phase 3.
✅ Phase 2 complete — test cases verified: all ACs covered, all fields populated, language correct

artifact-checklist.file: Test execution checklist — one [ ] per test; updated to ✅/❌ after Phase 5

quality-checklist.check: Both files exist at the correct paths INSIDE {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — NOT in any host project folder
Files are JavaScript — no TypeScript syntax, type annotations, or interface/type keywords
POM constructor accepts `page` and assigns `this.page = page`
All locators use `this.page.locator()` or Playwright locator methods
Spec imports the POM via correct relative path
Tests use `test.describe` + `test()` blocks — not bare function calls
Number of test cases covers all {ac_count} ACs — at least one positive test per AC
At least one negative test case per AC
No hardcoded base URLs — uses `baseURL` from config
No arbitrary `page.waitForTimeout()` — uses proper Playwright waiters
Every test has at least one `expect()` assertion

Every URL path in `page.goto()` calls is a valid, reachable route: a. Extract every unique path segment from all `page.goto()` calls in the spec (e.g., "/dashboard", "/auth/login") b. Cross-reference each path against `routes.pages` in {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json c. For any path NOT in project.config.json: read host project source to find the real route: Next.js: pages/ or app/ directory structure; React Router: src/**/routes* or App.* files; Vue Router: src/router/; Angular: app-routing.module.*; Express/Nest: routes* or *.controller.* d. Replace incorrect/invented paths with the actual routes found in source e. If a route cannot be confirmed, add a // TODO: verify route comment in the spec

review.fix-if-needed: P3-1 → move files to the correct path; remove any host project copies P3-2 → convert TypeScript syntax to plain JavaScript P3-3/P3-4 → fix POM structure P3-5/P3-6 → fix import path and test structure P3-7/P3-8 → add missing tests for uncovered ACs and negative scenarios P3-9 → replace hardcoded URLs with baseURL P3-10 → replace arbitrary waits with proper waiters P3-11 → add assertions to tests that lack them P3-12 → for each unrecognized URL path: read host project source files to find the real route; update the spec Save corrected files before proceeding to Phase 4.

step.output: ✅ Phase 3 complete — E2E files verified: correct path, JavaScript, all ACs covered, assertions present

step.action: Check {test_users} in config.yaml: - If {test_users} is NOT empty → use saved users directly, skip the prompt below - If {test_users} IS empty → ask the user: "I need test user credentials for Phase 4 (test data) and Phase 5 (test execution). Should I: A) Fetch them from your database automatically ({db_connection_string}) B) You provide them manually one by one Your choice?" Then load and execute workflow: {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/workflows/fetch-test-data/workflow.yaml WAIT for the workflow to complete and {test_users} to be saved before continuing.

quality-checklist.check: All 3 JSON data files exist at the correct paths
valid.json contains realistic positive data matching the story's domain
edge.json covers: empty strings, null values, maximum length strings, special characters, numeric boundaries
security.json contains: SQL injection payloads, XSS payloads, CSRF tokens, oversized inputs
All JSON files are valid parseable JSON
Data values are realistic for the domain — no generic "test123" or "foo" placeholders

review.fix-if-needed: P4-1 → create any missing JSON file with appropriate content P4-2 → replace generic placeholders with domain-specific realistic values P4-3 → add missing edge cases (empty, null, maxLength, special chars) P4-4 → add missing security payloads P4-5 → fix any malformed JSON Save corrected files before proceeding to Phase 5.

step.output: ✅ Phase 4 complete — test data verified: 3 files generated, realistic values, edge cases and security payloads included

step.action: Browser opens visually in {test_mode} mode using {default_browser}
Capture screenshots, videos, traces, JUnit XML

artifact-checklist.file: Test checklist — must now show ✅/❌ for each test that ran

quality-checklist.check: Test execution actually ran — results file exists and is not empty
Pass rate is a real calculated value — NOT a placeholder
Every test in the spec file appears in the results (no tests were silently skipped)
Failed tests have error messages and stack traces captured
Screenshots exist for any failed test
test-checklist.md has been updated — each test item now shows ✅ Passed, ❌ Failed, or ⏭️ Skipped; Progress table shows correct counts

review.fix-if-needed: P5-1 → if execution failed to start, diagnose the error (missing dependency, wrong path) and retry P5-3 → if tests were skipped, investigate skip reason and resolve P5-4 → if error details are missing, re-run the specific failing tests with verbose output P5-6 → if the checklist was not auto-updated, read the JUnit XML and manually update each checkbox in test-checklist.md

step.action: Triage all test failures and generate bug reports in {reporting_language}

artifact-checklist.file: Bug reports folder — must contain one report per failed test

quality-checklist.check: One bug report exists for every failed test from Phase 5 — no failure goes undocumented
Each report contains: bug ID, title, severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), steps to reproduce, actual result, expected result, root cause analysis
Severity is correctly classified — not every bug is "Critical"
Root cause analysis is specific — NOT generic ("unknown error" or "test failed")
All bug report content is in {reporting_language}
If pass rate is 100% and there are no failures, this step outputs "No bugs found" and skips report generation

review.fix-if-needed: P6-1 → create a bug report for any undocumented failure P6-2 → add any missing required field to each report P6-3 → re-evaluate severity based on impact (data loss/security = Critical, functional = High, UX = Medium) P6-4 → analyse the stack trace and error message to write a specific root cause P6-5 → translate all content to {reporting_language} Save corrected reports before proceeding to Phase 7.

step.output: ✅ Phase 6 complete — bug reports verified: one report per failure, severity classified, root cause specific

step.action: Aggregate all phase results into HTML dashboard + XLSX + MD summary

quality-checklist.check: All 3 report files exist
Pass rate matches the actual Phase 5 execution result
Bug count matches the number of reports in the bug-reports/ folder
All test results (pass and fail) are listed — none omitted
Quality gate result (PASSED / FAILED) is clearly stated
MD report contains: executive summary, pass rate, failed test list, bug severity breakdown, recommended next actions
All content is in {reporting_language}

review.fix-if-needed: P7-1 → re-run generate-report for any missing file P7-2/P7-3 → recalculate figures from source data; update all 3 files P7-4 → add any omitted test results P7-5 → add quality gate result prominently P7-6 → add missing MD sections P7-7 → translate all content to {reporting_language} Save corrected reports.

step.output: ✅ Phase 7 complete — QA report verified: all 3 formats generated, figures accurate, language correct

check.output: ⚠️ Quality gate FAILED — {pass_rate}% < {min_pass_rate}% — review bug reports before release
